title: The School Concert
description: Four recordings about a school concert: rehearsing, a phone call, a message and a headteacher's announcement.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Rehearsal
parts.intro: You will hear Minh and Lucy talking after a rehearsal.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Minh, you played the guitar really well today!

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Thanks, Lucy. I was nervous, though. I practised for an hour yesterday, but I still made two mistakes.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Nobody noticed. I'm more worried about my song. I forget the words in the second verse.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Don't worry. Mr Park will stand at the side of the stage and help you.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Good idea. What are you going to wear on Saturday?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: My black trousers and a white shirt. Our teacher says everybody must wear dark clothes, not bright ones.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Oh! I wanted to wear my yellow dress. I'll find a blue one instead.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: The concert starts at seven o'clock, but we have to arrive at six to get ready.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: OK. See you then!

parts.title: Part 2 · Buying tickets
parts.intro: You will hear a mother phoning the school office about tickets.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: Good afternoon, Greenfield School office.

script.speaker: Mrs Tran
script.text: Hello. I'd like to buy tickets for the school concert, please. My son is in the choir.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: Of course. Tickets are four pounds for adults and two pounds for children.

script.speaker: Mrs Tran
script.text: I need three tickets, then. Two for adults and one for my daughter. She's eight.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: That will be ten pounds, then. You can pay now by card, or at the door on Saturday.

script.speaker: Mrs Tran
script.text: I'll pay now, please. Are there any seats at the front?

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: I'm sorry, the front rows are full. But there are some good seats near the middle.

script.speaker: Mrs Tran
script.text: That's fine. Oh, and is there somewhere to park?

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: Yes, behind the sports hall. Please don't use the road, because it gets very busy.

parts.title: Part 3 · A message from the teacher
parts.intro: You will hear Miss Ward leaving a message for the choir.

script.speaker: Miss Ward
script.text: Hello, choir members. This is Miss Ward with some news about the concert.

script.speaker: Miss Ward
script.text: Because of the rain, we can't have the concert in the garden. We're going to use the main hall instead.

script.speaker: Miss Ward
script.text: We will practise on Friday after school, from four o'clock until half past five. Please don't be late, because we have a lot to do.

script.speaker: Miss Ward
script.text: Bring your music books, and remember to drink lots of water. A sore throat is terrible for a singer.

script.speaker: Miss Ward
script.text: Our special guest is a famous violin teacher. She will play two pieces before the choir sings. I'm sure you'll enjoy her music. See you on Friday!

parts.title: Part 4 · The headteacher's announcement
parts.intro: You will hear the headteacher, Mr Nguyen, speaking after the concert.

script.speaker: Mr Nguyen
script.text: Good evening, everyone, and thank you for coming to our school concert.

script.speaker: Mr Nguyen
script.text: The children worked very hard for three months. The best moment for me was the song from the youngest class. They were so cute, and they didn't make one mistake!

script.speaker: Mr Nguyen
script.text: We sold almost two hundred tickets tonight, and we collected three hundred and fifty pounds. We will use the money to buy new instruments for the music room.

script.speaker: Mr Nguyen
script.text: Now, there are drinks and cakes in the dining room. Parents, please remember that the children's coats are still in the classrooms.

script.speaker: Mr Nguyen
script.text: Finally, a photographer took pictures tonight. You can see them on the school website next week. Goodnight, and drive home carefully.
